description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 14.09.2015 - 20.09.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs exercising statutory powers, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
